description: This file defines data structures, enums, and function prototypes for handling X.509 certificates, including certificate parsing, attribute extraction, and memory management.

methods.name: x509GetValidNotBefore
methods.description: Returns the start date of the certificate's validity period as a heap-allocated string.

methods.name: x509GetValidNotAfter
methods.description: Returns the end date of the certificate's validity period as a heap-allocated string.

methods.name: x509GetSubjectCN
methods.description: Returns the subject's common name as a heap-allocated string.

methods.name: x509GetSubjectName
methods.description: Returns the subject distinguished name in RFC2253 format as a heap-allocated string.

methods.name: x509GetIssuerName
methods.description: Returns the issuer distinguished name in RFC2253 format as a heap-allocated string.

methods.name: x509GetPEM
methods.description: Converts an X509 certificate object to a PEM encoded string.

methods.name: x509CertLoadPEM
methods.description: Loads a PEM encoded X509 certificate from a file and returns a heap-allocated X509Cert.

methods.name: x509CertDestroy
methods.description: Releases memory associated with an X509Cert object.

methods.name: x509GeneralNameDestroy
methods.description: Releases memory for an X509GeneralName object.

methods.name: x509GetSubject
methods.description: Retrieves the structured subject name as an X509GeneralName.

methods.name: x509GetIssuer
methods.description: Retrieves the structured issuer name as an X509GeneralName.

methods.name: x509GetSubjectAltNames
methods.description: Returns a list of all subject alternative names in the certificate.

methods.name: x509GeneralNamesFormat
methods.description: Formats a list of X509GeneralName values into a descriptive string.

methods.name: x509GeneralNameFormat
methods.description: Formats a single X509GeneralName into a printable string.

methods.name: x509GeneralNameTypeToString
methods.description: Converts a X509GeneralNameType enum value to its string representation.
